additional_info.subject: 0369384 - ID0369384-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / R3 312719454/02] The load cuts off unexpectedly and randomly CRM:00641000597
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
Hope you are doing well,
Upon reviewing the logs on SCB, I've detected anomalies related to the CableTempSensor error of the DC1 cable. This error has recurred multiple times over the past week. Therefore, we suggest examining the cable temperature sensor of outlet DC1 and, if necessary, replacing the cable.
Please refer to the attached snapshot of the continuous error occurrences for further details.
And the error which has been generated that are,
'KON:'1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay,
RNE:'0 → in case of an sensor reading outside the defined operation range
'VIV:'0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
Kindly refer mentioned steps to be followed to trouble shoot the fault which is leading to this error flags.
Step 1:
Turn off the power supply to the charger.
Step 2:
Identify the cables P1, P2, N1 & N2 associated to Pt1000 refer below picture for your ref.
Step 3:
Check the ambient temperature and note it, then using multimeter measure the resistance of P1, P2, N1 & N2.
Step 4: Click on the following link to see the resistance table of Pt 1000 pertaining to the temperature and its corresponding resistance.
https://www.sterlingsensors.co.uk/pt1000-resistance-table
Kindly refer the below knowledge article to check the cable sensor,
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_HW_DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101 and EVSE_TempLowerLimit_ low temperature - Dynamics 365
,,
If you have any questions or need assistance with something, feel free to let me know. I’m here to help!
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Abhinav
